ShamiGo Windows v0.10.394 (released 2026-10-28)

Windows application EXE, admin launcher, and admin setup EXE are unchanged
from the audited v394 binary release. No input algorithm or UI feature version
is incremented by this documentation / distribution cleanup.

v394 includes a corrected version-aware allowlist for its standalone ZIP CMD
payloads, better partial ZIP extraction support, and administrator setup
failure diagnostics. New-install settings: light theme, 70 percent opacity,
2 seconds status/result notifications, 1 second Ctrl+Space hints. Existing
user data/settings are preserved by the intended installation procedures.

The private distribution retains licensed tables and full source projects.
The GitHub public distribution strips sources and licensed tables, including
embedded copies inside CMD and Linux VM archives. Users supply their own
properly licensed Liu table before starting or setting up a fresh install.

Linux package remains 0.10.366-1. macOS installer is not available.
Hardware verification of Windows 11 Explorer / UAC / VirtualBox is pending.
See README.md and Docs/CHANGELOG.md in the release root.
